tools.name: fill_word_search
tools.description: Completes a word search: takes the grid from generate_word_search (empty cells are "-") and fills them with random letters in the chosen language, with accents on or off. Letters follow how common they are in that language. Pass the puzzle's words so the filler never creates an extra copy of one.

tools.name: stylize_text
tools.description: Turns text into Unicode styles for social media bios and posts: bold, italic, script, fraktur, monospace, circled, squared, fullwidth, small caps, strikethrough, underline and more (22 styles). Accents are kept: an accented letter becomes its styled base letter plus the combining accent (ñ, ç, ü, ß

tools.name: list_styles
tools.description: The Unicode text styles stylize_text offers, with the id to pass, an English name and a category (bold-italic, sans, script, gothic, mono, enclosed, decoration, other).

tools.name: crossword
tools.description: Lays out a crossword from words with clues. Returns two matrices of the same size: puzzle (the game position: "-" is a blank cell, a word's number is on its first cell, "0" marks the other cells where a letter goes, and "a/d" such as "3/4" appears when an across word and a down word start in the sam

tools.name: sudoku
tools.description: Creates a sudoku with exactly one solution. Returns puzzle (0 = empty cell) and solution. Sizes 4, 6, 9 (default), 12 and 16; difficulty 1 easy (most clues) to 4 expert. Free, no usage limit. The same seed gives the same sudoku.

tools.name: solve_sudoku
tools.description: Solves a sudoku grid (0 = empty cell; sizes 4, 6, 9, 12, 16) and says whether the solution is the only one. Free, no usage limit.

tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: Languages Lettras supports, with the native letters each one adds to its grid alphabet.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "generate_word_search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
